mainEntity.name: How do I search the Bible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press Ctrl/⌘ F, or type "find" and the words in the palette. Results show how many verses, chapters and books matched, and each book opens to its verses.

mainEntity.name: How do I search for a whole word only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switch on "ab|" at the end of the search field: "man" then no longer matches "manner".

mainEntity.name: How do I search several translations at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the scope under the search field and add the translations to search. None chosen means the one being read.

mainEntity.name: How do I search only one book or testament?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the scope under the search field, choose where: the whole Bible, the open book, a testament, or a section such as the Gospels.
